summary: Attempted to append through a frequency key before creating its list for the first occurrence.
trigger: When appending an item to a dictionary bucket whose key may not have been seen yet.
corrected_rule: Create the empty bucket on first occurrence, or use an API that supplies a default list, before appending.
repair_prompt: In an original grouping task, show how the first and second items with the same unseen key are inserted without a missing-key failure.
